desc: Read the input string $S$ from standard input.
Construct the combined string $T = S[::-1] + \text{'\#'} + S$, ensuring the separator is not in the alphabet.
Compute the KMP prefix function (pi array) for the string $T$.
Retrieve the last value of the pi array, which represents the length of the longest palindromic suffix of $S$.
Implement the logic to construct the final palindrome by appending the reverse of the non-palindromic prefix to $S$.
Test with provided samples (ABC, Z, TREE).
Verify edge cases (single character, already palindrome).
